findings.evidence: Lines 79 and 87 are bare references to `MonoidAlgebra.scalarTensorEquiv_tmul` and `MonoidAlgebra.scalarTensorEquiv_symm_single`; Mathlib defines `BialgEquiv.ofAlgEquiv` separately in `Mathlib/RingTheory/Bialgebra/Equiv.lean:314` and exposes its application via `@[simps apply]`.
findings.fix: Rewrite the forward coercion using the generated `BialgEquiv.ofAlgEquiv_apply` lemma; prove the inverse formula by applying `scalarTensorBialgEquiv` and simplifying with the forward formula and `Equiv.apply_symm_apply`.
findings.issue: `scalarTensorBialgEquiv_tmul` and `scalarTensorBialgEquiv_symm_single` (line 87) close by directly supplying the corresponding `AlgEquiv` theorems, so both depend on undocumented definitional equality through `BialgEquiv.ofAlgEquiv`, especially its inverse wrapper.

summary: Two public formula proofs rely silently on definitional equality between the new bialgebra equivalence and its wrapped algebra equivalence.
